source_sample: UK - University of Strathclyde Current/Future Price.xlsx
description: UK University of Strathclyde file (xlsx, 9 columns, leading blank 'Update Type'). At 0% discount Price uses the raw GBP string from cst_uk_clp.csv for the period, otherwise a rounded discounted price; same layout as uni-hull apart from the last header. Customers exclude the SKUs in coupa_marketplace_excluded_uk.csv.

columns.expression: (lookup(row['sku'], 'cst_uk_clp.csv', 'uk_clp_future' if customer.get('price_period') == 'future' else 'uk_clp', '') if discount == 0 else '') or price_for_rounded(row, 'list_price_gbp', customer, discount)
